context.guidance: Give each Data Principal a summary of the Personal Data Elements held about them and of the processing done on that data, as §11(1)(a) requires. Where a sharing flow exists, list the Data Fiduciaries and Data Processors the data was shared with and what was shared, under §11(1)(b). Serve the summary through an in-app or request route that Rule 14 describes.

value.fix: Scope every query to the authenticated principal. Replace req.body.UserId with loggedInUser.data.id (the server-side session identity) in the MemoryModel.findAll call and in the matching reviews and orders lookups, and ignore any client-supplied user identifier. Return the actual personal data elements held (id, username, email, memories, orders, reviews) instead of the vowel-masked email, since masking prevents the data principal from getting an accurate copy. Add a summary section that lists each Personal Data Element held and the processing purposes applied to it, as §11(1)(a) requires. Where data is shared, list the Data Fiduciaries and Data Processors that received it and the categories shared, as §11(1)(b) requires. Serve the export and summary through an authenticated in-app or API route that follows the request-and-response process described in Rule 14, with identity verification, audit logging, and a response within the required timeframe. Verify with tests that a user cannot obtain another user's export by supplying a different UserId in the request body, and that the summary covers all held PDEs and recipients.
